unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The sudden loud sound in the dark gave her quite a fright.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 黑暗中突如其来的巨响吓了她一大跳。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：get a fright 受惊吓。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We skated happily on the frozen lake during winter vacation.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 寒假期间我们在结了冰的湖面上快乐地滑冰。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：frozen food 冷冻食品。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (动物)毛皮，软毛 `v.` 用毛皮覆盖
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She has beautiful fur.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 它长着漂亮的皮毛。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 天冷了，发 (fur) 我一件毛皮大衣。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The little girl gently stroked the cute furry rabbit.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 小女孩轻轻地抚摸着那只可爱毛茸茸的小兔子。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fur (毛皮) + y -> 毛茸茸的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You will gain valuable knowledge and experience through reading.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 通过阅读你将获得宝贵的知识和经验。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谚语记忆：No pain, no gain (没有付出就没有收获)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Mr. James Scott has a garage in Silbury and now he has just bought another garage in Pinhurst.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 詹姆斯·斯科特先生在锡尔伯里有一家车库，现在他刚在平赫斯特又买了一家车库。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想：ga(家) + rage(愤怒) -> 家里车库被废旧汽配塞满，令人愤怒。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A great cloud came out and became a genie!
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 一团巨大的云冒了出来，变成了一个精灵！
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 灯神**精灵**也是魔法天才 (genius)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A gentle spring breeze blew softly across the open fields.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 温柔的春风轻轻吹过开阔的田野。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：gentleman 绅士 -> gentle 温柔温和的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Well, large machines remove germs and other things from the water.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 嗯，大型机器能从水中去除细菌和其他杂质。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ge（哥）+ rm（人民）：哥哥告诉人民要远离细菌。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Children love telling spooky ghost stories around the campfire.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 孩子们喜欢在营火周围讲恐怖的鬼故事。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：ghost story 鬼故事。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Add fifty grams of white sugar to the cake mixture.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 在蛋糕混合料中加入五十克白糖。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 单位记忆：kilogram (千克) -> gram (克)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Mum poured warm, delicious gravy over the mashed potatoes.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 妈妈把温热美味的肉汁浇在土豆泥上。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 饮食文化：西餐中淋在肉和土豆上的肉汁（gravy）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A friendly smile and a warm greeting make everyone feel welcome.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 一个友善的微笑和一句亲切的问候让每个人都感到宾至如归。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：greet (动词问候) + ing -> greeting (问候语)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please do not chew gum during the English class.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 请不要在英语课上嚼口香糖。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：chewing gum 口香糖。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The gap between the haves and the have-nots narrowed over time.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 随着时间推移，富人和穷人之间的差距缩小了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 固定对比表达：the haves and the have-nots (富人与穷人)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 听力；听觉；审讯；听证会；(证人的)证词
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She can see and has great hearing.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她看得见，而且听力极好。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词干法: hear (听) 加 -ing 变成名词听觉。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Her new shoes rubbed against her heel and hurt her foot.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她的新鞋磨到了脚后跟，把脚弄疼了。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：Achilles' heel 致命弱点；阿喀琉斯之踵。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 骗局；恶作剧 `v.` 欺骗；戏弄
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The scary story turned out to be nothing more than an April Fools' hoax.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这个吓人的故事原来不过是个愚人节的恶作剧。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：play a hoax on sb. 对某人搞恶作剧。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: plan a treasure hunt
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 策划寻宝游戏
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 在寒(hun)冷的天气特(t)别喜欢打猎。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Later, a hunter caught the lion in a net.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 后来，一个猎人用网抓住了狮子。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: hunt打猎+er人=**猎人**。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 跨栏；障碍 `v.` 跨越障碍
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The young athlete cleared every hurdle smoothly and won first prize.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这位年轻的运动员顺利跨过每一个栏架，赢得了第一名。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 体育运动：hurdle race 跨栏赛跑。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Drivers must take extra care when driving along icy mountain roads.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 司机在结冰的山路上开车时必须格外小心。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：ice (冰) + y -> 结冰的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Learning common English idioms will make your conversations more natural.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 学习常见的英语习语会让你的对话更自然。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 语言学习：idioms 成语、习惯用语。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: People also kill elephants for their ivory.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 人们也为了象牙而猎杀大象。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 哎我日 (i-vo-ry)，偷猎者居然拔大象牙。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My uncle loves relaxing by listening to classic jazz on Saturday evenings.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我叔叔喜欢在周六晚上听经典爵士乐来放松。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 音译联想：爵士乐（jazz）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: go swimming/jogging/...
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 去游泳/慢跑/……
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法：赵哥（赵哥每天早上都在jog慢跑）

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 废旧物品；无价值的东西
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Eating too much junk food is bad for teenagers' health.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 吃太多垃圾食品对青少年的健康有害。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：junk food 垃圾食品。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The zoo keeper feeds the baby pandas fresh milk every day.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 动物园饲养员每天喂大熊猫宝宝新鲜牛奶。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：zoo keeper 动物饲养员；goalkeeper 守门员。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Tom is very keen on science and wants to be an astronaut.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 汤姆对科学非常热衷，想成为一名宇航员。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：be keen on 热衷于，喜爱。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Have you read the latest issue of our school English magazine?
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 你读过我们学校英语杂志的最新期吗？
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：the latest news 最新消息。
